name: Ivory
description: Tianxiang silk, slender waist jade belt dances with heavenly gauze, the breeze sends whispers to flying cloud bells, and the fragrance of flowers and spring charm attracts butterflies, as if they are descending from nine heavenly fairies. The silk and satin transform into four-color gauze, and the curling singing voice condenses into transparent bells, dancing and chanting in the wind. The heavenly fragrance and national charm spread to the sky.
